Messages.Author: gman
Messages.Body:
Here are the details for the 2014 North West Qualifier coming up on Saturday April 19th. The qualifier will take place at the Contac gaming convention in Tacoma Washington.

Location
Contac www.warhorn.net/events/contac
Shilo Inns and Suites.
7414 South Hosmer St.
Tacoma WA 98408
Phone: 253 475 4020

Schedule
Registration: 10:00am - 10:30am
R1: 10:30am - 12:30pm
Break:
R2: 1:30pm - 3:30pm
R3: 3:30pm - 5:30pm
Final: 5:30pm - 7:30pm

Note that this time table could change during the course of the tournament due to rounds running longer or shorter than expected.

Lodging
The Shilo has rooms available for around $89 a night. If this is out of your budget, please contact me for other options.

Transportation
I'll be driving down to Tacoma from Seattle on Saturday and have plenty of room in my car. Let me know if you'd like to reserve a spot. I'll be picking folks up in the Northgate Mall parking lot at 8:30am (in front of the Barnes & Noble). I'd like to get to the shilo by 9:30am.

Entry Fee $0

Prize Support
Prizes will be provided for this event. There will be a drawing to select door prize winners.

Reminder
Remember to remove all proxy cards from your tournament deck. If that leaves you short on cards, please contact me. I'll be loaning cards to anyone that needs them (while supplies last). Also, if you've been out of the game for a while, and you need a deck, just let me know. I have no problem putting together a deck for you to borrow.

Danse Macabre
Some print-at-home cards are now legal for tournament play. This is limited to those cards provided in the Danse Macabre expansion. Please see the vekn website for details on how to use these.

Other Vtes Events

We have no other events planned, but if there is enough interest, let's see about getting some casual games in Friday night. Let me know if you're in. We could also schedule games for Easter Sunday if people are interested.

-grayson

Messages.Author: gman

Okay, we had a pretty strong turnout last night - ten players. 6 of us (including myself) are able to commit to games on Friday April 18th. I realize that's one too many, but I'm confident we'll be able to wrangle up a few others. I'm thinking we'll cancel our weekly Thursday games and ask people to come out on Friday instead. This likely wouldn't be a tournament, but casual games (which tend to be just as competitive as our tournaments ). I'm thinking it would be best to have these games in Tacoma (about 45 minutes south of Seattle), the same location as the Qualifier. Those who plan on staying at the Shilo will also find this more convenient.

For Easter Sunday, we currently have 5 players (including myself) who can commit. I spoke to a few other folks who will likely make it but couldn't commit at this time. Since most of us are in the Seattle area, I'm thinking it would be cool if we held games at either Card Kingdom or the Heartland Cafe. This is still up for discussion.

So, I believe we have enough interest to make this a Friday-Sunday event. Let me know if you can make out to out.

I do have a couch still available if someone is needing a place to stay. As mentioned before, I'll be available to transport people staying in the Seattle area. Just let me know what your plans are.

-Grayson

Messages.Author: TryDeflectingThisGrapple
Messages.Body:
Grayson will be posting a summary and the winning deck list in the results forum later, but here's a synopsis from my viewpoint.

3 tables with lots of fun people, 14 people I think. Totally enjoyable, very nice people.

Overall meta: Very heavily focused on DOM bleed/bounce with scattered DEM bleed (in part because that's what Qualifiers tend to bring out, in part because DOM and wake/intercept appear typical for the PCN meta).

Of course, the pair of us from Denver chose to play non-DOM, non-AUS decks, making us the only people in the tournament without bounce

Finals were:

John (#5 seed, Seattle) playing "Yes" - midcap AUS Target Vitals.
Steven (#1 seed, Seattle) playing Stani - prototypical DOM/PRO
Darby (#4 seed, Denver) playing "Workhorse with No Name" - Unnamed multiaction bleedbox.
Brian (#1 seed, Seattle) playing large cap AUS/CEL guns w/ Villein
Kelly (#3 seed, Denver) playing "Kelly Highway" - large cap vote-n-bloat

It went down as the seating pretty much dictated (Brian wins, 3 VP).

More involved summary:

I get close to ousting Brian 3 straight turns but I can't draw the Enkil Cog (note to self, buy a second copy).

Steven's DOM ousts me before I can finish Brian despite "Yes" stopping every [DOM] GtA attempt. Brian is far more willing to block Stani than he was to block the Unnamed, so Steven shuts down.

Meanwhile, the dual AUS decks completely stuff Kelly, who takes ZERO successful actions other than hunt/rescue.

In the end, the intercept decks are heads-up and permanent combat wins out over transient combat. Congrats Brian - very well played.
